blind.description: A freestanding rectangular cut-rock wall section featuring stylized, hand-painted chiseled stone facets on its primary faces. The top edge is flat with subtle beveling, the vertical ends are flat and vertical to allow modular tiling, and the bottom sits flat on the floor without a separate base. Color palette consists of warm earth browns and slate greys with darker, slightly mossy shading along the base.
blind.from_above: A thick, slightly irregular horizontal rectangle with rounded corners and subtle rocky contours along the front and back faces.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1.3 to 1.4 times taller than the 5 ft 9 in figure (approximately 7.5 to 8 ft tall), and roughly 3.5 to 4 ft wide.
